messages:
maria_cs: Quick weekly check-in for GreenWave — noticed a bump in error rate this week, can we get a brief breakdown? 5xx/timeouts/rate limits and top endpoints causing the noise?

devin_sre: Looking now. initial alert came Friday morning. quick summary: 5xx up from 0.5% -> 2.8%, timeouts up ~3x, rate-limited calls steady at 0.7%.

sam_eng: Pushing an ad-hoc query to prod logs to pull top failing routes now. will paste results.

sam_eng: ```sql
SELECT path, count(*) AS failures, error_type
FROM api_logs
WHERE account_id = 'gw-231' AND status >= 500
  AND timestamp >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY path, error_type
ORDER BY failures DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

devin_sre: Raw results: /v1/generate (502) 4,120 fails; /v1/chat/stream (timeout) 2,300; /v1/embed (429) 610; /v1/generate?model=large (504) 980.

maria_cs: Oof — /v1/generate is the heavy hitter. GreenWave reported latency spikes in onboarding flows last week which aligns. Renewal flagging: jules, do you want to escalate?

jules_ae: Yes, I'll flag renew risk if we don't have a mitigation path within 48h. Need root cause and ETA. Can eng estimate impact window?

sam_eng: Early hypothesis: a backend downstream (kv-cache) causing 502 amplification under certain prompt shapes — seen more with longer contexts. Also seeing intermittent Nginx upstream timeouts for streaming endpoint.

devin_sre: Repro steps: small load test against /v1/generate with sequence length ~2048 bumped error rate. I put a temporary routing rule to fall back to a smaller model for GreenWave yesterday evening. That dropped 502s by ~55% during the test window.

maria_cs: Thanks. Can we list recommended immediate actions (1-3) we can present to customer? Keep it customer-facing simple.

sam_eng: 1) Temporary: enable model fallback for long-context requests (we already toggled it). 2) Mitigate: increase KV-cache capacity and raise upstream timeout to 45s for streaming route. 3) Longer term: patch attention kernel that trips on certain prompt tokenization.

devin_sre: Adding monitoring: created alert greenwave-5xx-above-1pct -> paging to SRE if >1% sustained 10m. Also adjusted autoscaler min replicas +1 for dedicated pool for gw-231.

jules_ae: I'll tell GreenWave we're on it and that we applied a fallback that reduced errors. Ask if they can brief on any unusual long-context workloads in last 2 weeks.

maria_cs: Can we capture one-pager for account health that I can share with exec sponsor? Include: current error breakdown, top endpoints, actions taken, expected next update time.

sam_eng: I'll draft the snippet. quick breakdown numbers to include: 5xx: 2.8% -> main contributors /v1/generate (502s) and /v1/generate?model=large (504s); timeouts: streaming /v1/chat/stream up 3x; rate limits: /v1/embed 429 spikes at 0.7% of calls.

opsbot: Incident note created: INC-2026-3287 linked to gw-231. Assigned: devin_sre, sam_eng.

maria_cs: Target: send one-pager to GreenWave and internal execs by EOD tomorrow. devin/sam confirm ETA for the patch and capacity changes?

sam_eng: Capacity bump done (increased pool by 2 gpus) — completed. Kernel patch ETA 72h, can fast-track to 36h if we onboard one additional reviewer.

devin_sre: Timeout config change queued; rolling deploy tonight, no downtime expected.

jules_ae: Perfect. I'll schedule the customer update for tomorrow 3pm PT. If numbers worsen, will escalate earlier. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll compile the one-pager and drop the draft here for review before sending. Will also add a renewal risk note to the account record.
